thesis: Every other flow asks what you want to buy. This one asks whether your family can carry on without you.
sub: Deterministic formulas and rules, no machine learning. Every number on screen can be traced to an input, a formula, a rule ID and a config version.

story.title: Tap the "Arjun" persona
story.body: A verdict and range appear straight away, with no personal details asked.

story.title: Open the gap: ₹2.39 Cr
story.body: The waterfall adds up to the gap. Tap any bar to see its formula, inputs and config IDs.

story.title: Ask "why not ₹1 Cr?"
story.body: ₹1 Cr runs out after the loan and about 7½ years of living costs. Assumption swings are one table away.

story.title: See term first, savings plans locked
story.body: Drag the cover slider: the premium comes from the rate table, and the surrender table shows what early exit costs.

story.title: Book, then show the advisor's view
story.body: Reality check, slot and consent, then the one-page handoff and the decision trail.

formulas:
Real rate        r = (1 + d) ÷ (1 + g) − 1
Annuity factor   AF = (1 − (1 + r)^−n) ÷ r      (r ≠ 0; AF = n when r ≈ 0)
Annuity due      AF_due = AF × (1 + r)

HLV  = I × (1 − e) × AF        ordinary annuity, n = years to retirement
Need = loans + living cost × AF_due(i) + education
       + marriage + health and emergency + spouse retirement
Gap  = Need − own death cover − employer cover − allocated savings
formulaNote: d discount rate, g income growth, i expense inflation, n years, I income, e own-spending share. Guards: r ≤ −1 rejected; r < 0 caps n at A-MAX-HORIZON; n ≤ 0 gives HLV 0; full precision internally, rounded only for display.

rules.when: Lifelong dependant or estate need, and affordable
Term gap closed and budget left over

rules.then: Lower cover → change term → drop riders → advisor
Show both; route to advisor; need not capped

rules.when: Outside age, term or cover limits
rules.then: Excluded, with reason and nearest eligible
Keep + term if both fit the budget, else paid-up + term, else stop + term

revealDay.body: 14 products and rate tables, 200 profiles, 15 advisors and slots

adapters.title: Adapters
adapters.body: Map each file into our schema with a mapping file. The only code touched on the day.

core.title: Versioned config
core.body: Assumptions, income bands, caps, surrender schedules

engines.title: Calc engine
engines.body: Pure functions: needs, HLV, gap, guards, explain

engines.title: Rate lookup
engines.body: Keyed by whatever dimensions exist; exact or nearest cell; never extrapolates

outputs.title: Scheduler
outputs.body: SQLite; slot locked in one transaction; idempotency key

outputs.title: Decision trail
outputs.body: Append-only; rule ID and config version on every row

outputs.title: Handoff pack
outputs.body: One page for the advisor; access logged and time-limited

openQuestions: All assumption defaults, income multiples, insurer-cap multiples and the 6% budget limit are placeholders for a finance reviewer.

The A-MAX-HORIZON guard applies only when the real rate is negative (as specified), so HLV jumps at r = 0 when working years exceed 40. A reviewer should choose whether to cap always (DECISIONS D-17).
Special surrender value (A-SSV) is a placeholder schedule; surrender, paid-up and maturity figures are illustrative.
Remuneration disclosure wording is a placeholder for compliance.
